about: 40 emotes played on the Roblox avatar; each player picks 8 for their emote wheel (B) in the Locker. unlock: default = everyone has it (the first 7); obby = finish the obby; victory = win a Victory Royale; kills = lifetime eliminations reach 'need' (150 unlocks the last one); wins = Victory Royales reach 'need'; range = score 'need' in one shooting-range round (match.rangeRoundSeconds); bullseyes = hit 'need' bullseyes at the range in all. Fairer since test9 (creator): nothing needs more than 150 kills or 8 wins, and the range unlocks only took over items that needed 100+ kills, so nobody lost one. Each loops over 'loopSeconds' through its keyframes (emote_keys).
